description: This file contains functions and constants for configuring and managing PostgreSQL database settings for testing purposes in the Mattermost project, including generating DSNs, creating and dropping test databases, and handling database connection parameters.

methods.name: getDefaultPostgresqlDSN
methods.description: Returns the default PostgreSQL DSN, replacing localhost with postgres if running in CI environment.

methods.name: PostgreSQLSettings
methods.description: Returns database settings for connecting to a PostgreSQL test database with a randomly generated name.

methods.name: postgreSQLRootDSN
methods.description: Generates a root DSN for PostgreSQL by setting the database to 'postgres'.

methods.name: postgreSQLDSNDatabase
methods.description: Extracts the database name from a DSN URL.

methods.name: databaseSettings
methods.description: Creates a SqlSettings object with specified driver and data source, with preset connection parameters.

methods.name: execAsRoot
methods.description: Executes a SQL command as root user on the test database.

methods.name: MakeSqlSettings
methods.description: Creates a new test database, grants permissions, and returns the corresponding SqlSettings.

methods.name: CleanupSqlSettings
methods.description: Drops the test database associated with the provided SqlSettings.
